youth.description: Employees under 18 may work at night, on weekends or on public holidays only under a statutory sector exception (§§ 14, 16–18 JArbSchG). Record why it applies; it covers the shift as shown here.

youth.loadFailed: Could not load youth protection findings.
youth.nightConfirms: Recording this confirms that one of these § 14 JArbSchG permissions applies to this work: hospitality or fairgrounds until 22:00 (from 16, Abs. 2 Nr. 1); multi-shift operations until 23:00 (from 16, Abs. 2 Nr. 2), or from 05:30 or until 23:30 after notifying the supervisory authority (Abs. 5 S. 2); agriculture from 05:00 or until 21:00 (from 16, Abs. 2 Nr. 3); bakeries and pastry shops from 05:00 (from 16, Abs. 2 Nr. 4), or bakeries from 04:00 (from 17, Abs. 3); until 21:00 from 15 where the usual working time ends after 20:00 for transport reasons, after notifying the supervisory authority (Abs. 5 S. 1); from 05:00 from 15 in a workplace with extraordinary heat in the warm season (Abs. 6). It also confirms that § 14 Abs. 4 does not exclude it: no work after 20:00 under Abs. 2 Nr. 1–3 on the day before a vocational school day whose lessons start before 09:00; and that the minor is no longer subject to full-time compulsory schooling (§ 2 Abs. 3) or works during school holidays, at most four weeks per calendar year (§ 5 Abs. 4); otherwise the rules for children apply and no exception does.
